# ADR-3263: AWS root_mfa: Organization SCP deny-root-keys setting for ou 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Account-local discipline fails under pressure.

## Decision

Organizations SHALL apply an organization SCP deny-root-keys setting for ou 7 (AWS-root_mfa-7).

## Consequences

SCPs provide a hard guardrail.
